forbidden_elements: Yellow color (strictly forbidden across the entire application)
Space Grotesk font (forbidden by E1 protocol)

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-12), Asymmetrical grids for visual interest, Grid borders for technical precision.

components.hero: Modern full-width with abstract blue textures or professional cleaning imagery overlay. Max overlay opacity bg-blue-900/40. Left-aligned heavy typography.
components.product_card: Minimalist card with 1px border. Hover effect: subtle lift (-translate-y-1), drop-shadow-xl. Action button 'Add to Cart' appears on hover. Product image background should be pure white.
components.cart: Shadcn Sheet component sliding from right. Must include item list, quantity adjusters, subtotal, and 'Proceed to Checkout' button.
components.checkout: Multi-step flow. Clean, distraction-free environment. Input fields must use Shadcn forms with crisp borders. Include 'Coupon Code' input and display 'PJ Wholesale Discount' dynamically.
components.whatsapp_widget: Floating action button fixed to bottom-right (z-50). Uses custom blue or neutral color (NOT yellow or green if it clashes with the brand, though green is standard for WhatsApp, user specified NO yellow, standard WhatsApp green #25D366 is allowed if it doesn't break the deep blue palette, else stick to blue).
components.badges: Use sharp, high-contrast badges (e.g., bg-blue-900 text-white) for 'Atacado' (Wholesale) or 'Promo' labels.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion fade-in and slide-up for staggered grid elements.

hero_background.description: Deep blue abstract background with wavy lines, perfect for a high-end corporate hero section overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'Inter' for body.
Configure Tailwind with the exact colors provided. ABSOLUTELY NO YELLOW (#FFFF00, #FBBF24, etc.). Use semantic variables for primary and secondary.
Implement Google Social Login button on the Auth modal/page.
Create a toggle or distinct flow for 'Pessoa Física (PF)' and 'Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)' registration.
The shopping cart must be a sliding 'Sheet' component from Shadcn.
Implement a multi-step checkout with coupon validation and a fixed PJ wholesale discount dynamically calculated.
WhatsApp floating button must appear on all pages and trigger a chat interface that sends messages to a WhatsApp number.
Create an Admin Panel specific for managing Discount Coupons.
Highlight categories and product catalog using responsive CSS grids. Product cards must have an 'Atacado' badge if applicable.
Footer should include detailed contact information and links to policies.
DO NOT USE Space Grotesk. DO NOT USE Yellow.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').
